nota: Paquetes de producción del carril AV (AUDIOVISUAL_GROK.md §6). tools/av/armar_paquetes.py los convierte en un .zip por paquete con las referencias y el prompt listos para subir a Grok Imagine (plan Ultra: 1080p, hasta 15 s, varias imágenes de referencia).

paquetes.audio: sí: viento, aletazos y selva; sin música ni voces
paquetes.prompt: Cinematic promotional shot for Amazona Verse, a stylized 3D tropical adventure game from Puerto Rico. The character is Vittata, the official Puerto Rican Amazon parrot shown in ALL the supplied reference images: use them as the authoritative design. Keep her exactly as in the references: bright green body, red forehead patch, large white eyes with blue irises, big yellow beak, yellow feet, friendly cartoon proportions, same face and same 3D toon rendering. Shot: she stands on a mossy branch high in a lush tropical rainforest canopy at golden morning light, looks toward the camera with a confident smile, spreads her wings and takes off; the camera follows her in a smooth tracking shot as she flies over a sea of jungle treetops, a river glinting below, distant misty mountains. Mood: freedom, wonder, adventure. Style: polished vibrant stylized 3D game cinematic, saturated warm greens, turquoise water, soft warm sunlight, atmospheric depth. Constraints: do not redesign the character; no extra limbs; no change of colors, eyes, beak or proportions; no realistic bird anatomy; no text, logos, flags or watermarks; no other characters; no buildings. 15 seconds, 16:9, 1080p.
aceptacion: Kelvin reconoce a Vittata en el primer, el medio y el último fotograma
Colores, ojos, pico y proporciones iguales a las referencias
Sin deformaciones ni alas o patas de más

paquetes.prompt: Cinematic establishing shot for Amazona Verse, a stylized 3D tropical adventure game. Use the supplied images as the authoritative design of the legendary City of the 36: a great city of cream and white stone towers with domes, cornices and battlements on top of a tall tepui rock, wrapped in dense rainforest, with a second group of towers on the rock to the left. Camera: slow aerial drone approach from far away through light clouds, revealing the jungle, the tepui walls and finally the city in warm late-afternoon sun; birds fly in the distance. Keep the architecture, layout and colors exactly as in the references; do not invent new buildings or styles. Mood: awe, mystery, a legendary place waiting to be discovered. Style: polished vibrant stylized 3D game cinematic, saturated greens, cream matte stone, soft warm light, atmospheric haze. No characters, no text, logos or watermarks. 15 seconds, 16:9, 1080p.
aceptacion: Se reconoce la ciudad de la meta de Kelvin (torres crema, cúpulas, el conjunto de la izquierda)
